PORTFOLIO OS v3.1 — PRODUCTION CODEBASE REVIEW PACK FOR GEMINI ARGON

System Overview:
Portfolio OS is a local-first personal investment management and automated portfolio rebalancing system structured across 5 integrated tiers:
1. Java Core Node (Spring Boot 3.2.5 on Java 21/27):
   - Cryptographic append-only SQLite HMAC-SHA256 ledger & transactional event sourcing.
   - Real-time in-process DuckDB analytical projection & valuation.
   - Section 112A / 50AA FIFO tax engine with Jan 31 2018 grandfathering & LTCG tax-harvesting.
   - Macro regime cash-buffer router & rebalancing waterfall engine.
   - Tool-calling agent discovery endpoints & strict token-authenticated API.
2. Web Cockpit (Svelte 5 / Vite / Glassmorphic UI):
   - Executive overview, Scheme Tax Lots with LTCG maturation countdown, and Unified Rebalance & FIRE views.
   - Indian Rupee formatting (Lakhs/Crores), local Quiet Mode privacy masking, and ARIA accessibility.
3. Python Quant Sidecar (FastAPI):
   - Intra-bucket Hierarchical Risk Parity (HRP) allocation & covariance clustering.
   - Parametric & Historical CVaR risk bounds calculation.
   - CAS PDF & broker CSV portfolio transaction parsers.
4. Rust TUI (Ratatui):
   - Native ultra-low-latency terminal dashboard with real-time portfolio metrics, sparklines, and allocation overlays.
5. Android Companion App (Kotlin / Jetpack Compose):
   - Material 3 Expressive UI, ObsidianCard glassmorphism, biometric authentication, offline snapshot caching, and Glance home-screen widget.

Key Review Objectives for Gemini Argon:
- Architectural contracts between Core Node, Web Cockpit, Quant Sidecar, Rust TUI, and Android client.
- Financial math & tax engine precision (FIFO lot matching, grandfathered FMV logic, rebalancing waterfall budget conservation).
- Concurrency, locking, and data integrity (HMAC chain verification, DuckDB projection sync, transactional state management).
- Security posture (token interceptor, secret isolation, input sanitization).
- Verification of remediations from Phases 1-6 (clean test suites, zero broken links, robust error handlers).
